content.Guideline Overview: The document is from Vitari et al., detailing the 2023 AHA/ACC/ACCP/ASPC/NLA/PCNA Chronic Coronary Disease Guideline. It references multiple studies and updates from ACC/AHA regarding cardiovascular disease management.
Key Points: Focus on stable ischemic heart disease management: Reports from various associations including the American College of Cardiology and the American Heart Association.
Updates on dual antiplatelet therapy duration in patients with coronary artery disease.
Prevention and management of patients with atrial fibrillation, valvular heart disease, heart failure, and sudden cardiac death.
Sexual activity and cardiovascular disease implications.
